# teleportconnect_node (Data Source)

Looks up a Teleport SSH node by hostname and/or label match. Useful for resolving a `gateway_node` for teleportconnect_ssh_tunnel by labels instead of hardcoding hostnames.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve a Teleport SSH node by hostname.
data "teleportconnect_node" "by_hostname" {
  hostname = "bastion-1"
}

# Resolve a Teleport SSH node by labels.
data "teleportconnect_node" "bastion" {
  labels = {
    role = "bastion"
  }
}

output "bastion_hostname" {
  value = data.teleportconnect_node.bastion.matched_hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Exact hostname to match. At least one of `hostname` or `labels` must be set.
- `labels` (Map of String) Map of labels (all must match exactly).

### Read-Only

- `addr` (String) Network address of the matched node.
- `all_labels` (Map of String) All labels on the matched node.
- `id` (String) Same as matched_name, exposed as `id` for consistency.
- `matched_hostname` (String) Hostname of the matched node.
- `matched_name` (String) Teleport-internal node name (typically a UUID).
